briefTitle: A Cooperative Clinical Study of Abatacept in Multiple Sclerosis (ACCLAIM) (ITN035AI)
armDescription: Participants in this arm receive intravenous abatacept (CTLA4-Ig; Orencia®) as their initial course of treatment, with dosing adjusted by body weight.
